newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil federal tax receipts 8.7 bln reais in May.
newsitem.headline: Brazil federal tax receipts 8.7 bln reais in May.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts in May totalled 8.716 billion reais, up 7.42 percent from the same month last year, the Finance Ministry's Tax Secretariat said on Friday.
May's figure took total tax receipts for the first five months of the year to 44.659 billion reais, 5.19 percent higher than in the January-May period last year, the secretariat said in a statement.

The statement attributed the the improved receipts in May compared with May 1996 to the introduction in February of the CPMF tax on financial transactions, a levy aimed at raising funds for Brazil's ailing health service.

May receipts were 10.11 percent lower than April's, a fact attributed to May having only four working weeks as opposed to April's five. Also, more income tax came due in April than in May, the statement said.
